parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. It can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description: The order type. Valid value: Renewal.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The renewal duration for all subscription resources of the service instance. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description: The unit of the renewal duration for all subscription resources of the service instance. This is the unit for the Period parameter. Valid values: Month and Year. Default value: Month.

parameters.name: ResourcePeriod
parameters.description: The renewal configuration for the resources.

sub_parameters.name: Period
sub_parameters.description: The renewal duration. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit.

sub_parameters.name: PeriodUnit
sub_parameters.description: The unit of the renewal duration for the resource. This is the unit for the Period parameter. Valid values: Month and Year. Default value: Month.

sub_parameters.name: ResourceArn
sub_parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.
